levels.name: 特殊Root
levels.meaning: 高于所有其他管理员；跨最高管理与名单联合；不可禁用

required: max(action base, native-stamped channel floor, intervention floor); symbolic target-relative management formulas resolved before comparison
scope: ordinary highest own whitelist only; Root own plus all highest; explicit valid delegation scope may narrow corresponding actions, never caller-package source penalty
highestRisk: per-action label, not every action of a numerically high identity; outside applicable whitelist requires bounded owner grant even for Root. Missing grant caps effective below that action requirement.
compiledFields: high-risk floors and static action admission
device public keys and owning highest/root mapping
runtimeMutableOnly: disable/reinstate records for already compiled identities under strict rules
below-H signed low delegations within issuer scope
revocation/reinstatement of already compiled device exemptions, never new device key/owner mapping
short owner grants and session records
channelBoundary: Native adapter stamps channel; client cannot claim USB to lower floor. App cannot reliably distinguish physical/wireless ADB from shell UID. Equal valid proof on equivalent signed channel has equal authority regardless helper package/signature.

ownerGrant.freshSystemOwnerCheck: platform credential/biometric when lock configured, OS-positive no-lock exception plus explicit local consent otherwise; no caller-crafted success
ownerGrant.scopeExpansion: never raises identity beyond its registered/delegated level or adds high identity

sourceContinuityException: R4 four-step personal source guard remains mandatory, with two separate fresh checks; no admin/whitelist bypass, no business unlock before verified old-private erasure/new epoch commit

disableLedger.local: signed installation-local monotonic journal, survives ordinary same-source updates
disableLedger.distribution: export/import signed revocation snapshots explicitly; no claim offline devices instantly know changes; no default public listener
disableLedger.disable: any actor strictly above target, target not Root; no issuer-subtree-only limitation
disableLedger.restore: same enabled issuer may withdraw own record if still above target; other actor must be strictly above original disabling issuer (thus above target)
disableLedger.multipleRecords: all applicable active disable records must be cleared, never one restore silently erases peer records
disableLedger.issuerLaterDisabled: previous valid disable records remain; disabling issuer does not automatically resurrect targets
disableLedger.corruptState: fail closed for affected non-root management, retain compiled Root route; malformed root-disable ignored/rejected, never disable Root

revisit: change numeric thresholds only in reviewed signed APK policy update; never runtime lower H or raise low principals into high capabilities
